<?php
trait T {
    public const Y = [static function () { echo self::class, ":", static::class, ";"; }, E_STRICT][0];
    public static $x = self::Y;
    public static function m(object $v = new self(7)) {
        echo self::class, ":", static::class, ":", $v instanceof C ? "C" : "X", ";";
    }
}
set_error_handler(function () { echo "H;"; return true; });
class C {
    use T;
    public static $x = self::Y;
    public function __construct(int $v) { echo "CTOR:", $v, ";"; }
}
$f = C::m(...);
echo "CALL;";
$f();
unset($f);
echo "AFTER;";
(C::$x)();
